trials.claim: Plan 1 includes lifetime access to the Link Chest by SEO Buddy
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to the Link Chest by SEO Buddy
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports buying lifetime access and later losing access with a licence upgrade demanded, which directly conflicts with lifetime access. Initial access confirmed by another buyer does not show it was kept for life.

exhibits.quote: "Lifetime" means the commercial lifetime of the specific product purchased: for as long as we offer it, your access does not renew, does not expire and costs nothing further.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access ends when the vendor stops offering the product, so it is not permanent.

exhibits.quote: I bought a lifetime access on my email and now I don't have access it asks for licence upgrade!
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports lifetime access was revoked and an upgrade was demanded.

exhibits.quote: After purchasing the life time deal, I did gain access to link chest but I noticed that our subscription was highly limited.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms a lifetime deal purchase did give access to Link Chest.

trials.claim: The Link Chest is a collection of high-quality, easy-to-win backlink opportunities
trials.claimQuote: The Link Chest is a collection of high-quality, easy-to-win backlink opportunities
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report useless, low-quality, spammy, outdated and mislabelled links, directly conflicting with high-quality, easy-to-win opportunities. This outweighs one positive review calling the sites high-profile.

exhibits.quote: it was just a bunch of useless links, either profiles that will never be indexed, so they're useless for SEO, or low-quality, spammy sites that will never be indexed.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports the links are useless, low-quality and spammy rather than high-quality.

exhibits.quote: Some Links are marked as "DoFollow" but are "NoFollow" meanwhile or public backlinks are unpublic in the meanwhile.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports the database is outdated and mislabeled, undermining easy-to-win quality claims.

exhibits.quote: Known link opportunities with the submission page and step-by-step guides.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes Link Chest as known link opportunities with submission guidance.

exhibits.quote: The site lists hundreds of high profile websites where you can get backlinks.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Link Chest lists hundreds of high-profile sites for backlinks.

trials.claim: Plan 1 promises to save days of work and focus on action
trials.claimQuote: Save yourself days of work (and focus on action)
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms the software does save time compared with hunting for sites yourself, supporting the time-saving promise. One buyer getting no backlink does not show the list did not save hunting time.

exhibits.quote: Despite spending hours working through the provided list of backlink opportunities, I was unable to achieve a single functioning backlink.
exhibits.argument: A buyer spent hours with zero results, contradicting the promise to save days of work.

exhibits.quote: Thanks, this is going to save me a lot of time.
exhibits.argument: Customer statement on vendor site confirms the product saves significant time.

exhibits.quote: you can hunt for the sites yourself, but the software does save you time.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the software saves time versus hunting sites manually.
